description.value: The study investigated long-term recognition and subsequent memory effects of negative and neutral pictures after cognitive emotion regulation during encoding, using fMRI one year later.

spans.text: In order to investigate the neural effects of emotion regulation on long-term memory, we studied memory in subjects 1 year after they participated in an emotion regulation experiment.

value: we expected to find effects of successful recognition as well as a subsequent memory effect during encoding in regions of the MTL, including the amygdala, only in cases where emotions were experienced in a natural way, but not when subjects regulated their emotions during encoding.

spans.text: Therefore, we expected to find effects of successful recognition as well as a subsequent memory effect during encoding in regions of the MTL, including the amygdala, only in cases where emotions were experienced in a natural way, but not when subjects regulated their emotions during encoding.
